chunks: Indeed, the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله used to say to the one returning from Makkah: “May Allah accept from you, replace for you your expenditure, and forgive your sin.”

key_terms.رَسُولَ اللَّهِ: the Messenger of Allah, the Prophet Muhammad صلى الله عليه وآله
key_terms.قَبِلَ: accepted; here, acceptance of the act of worship
key_terms.مَكَّةَ: Makkah, the sanctuary associated with hajj and pilgrimage
key_terms.نَفَقَتَكَ: your expenditure or expenses spent on the journey

ai.seo_question: What did the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله say to someone returning from Makkah?
ai.summary: This hadith reports a supplication the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله would say to someone returning from Makkah. It reflects the etiquette of congratulating the returning pilgrim with du'a for acceptance, compensation of expenses, and forgiveness of sins.
